summary.en: The fixed-grid comparison gives PF-to-PE u-error ratios of 7.27, 0.588, 0.475 for the two one-soliton tests and the two-soliton test, respectively. The largest relative difference between RK4 and C–N terminal errors is 0.119%. The moving mesh lowers 18 of the eighteen field errors; the percentage changes, measured as reductions relative to the corresponding fixed-grid errors, range from 3.13% to 12.5%.
summary.zh: 固定网格下，两组单孤子和二孤子的 PF 与 PE 的 u 误差比分别为 7.27、0.588、0.475。RK4 与 C–N 终止误差的最大相对差异为 0.119%。动网格使十八组物理场比较中的 18 组误差降低；以对应固定网格误差为基准，降幅范围为 3.13% 至 12.5%。
